rounding

```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```
repetition
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))
print(rep(x=5, times = 7))
```
different types of variables

```{r}
character_variable <- "hello"
print(character_variable)
print(class(character_variable))
numerical_variable <- 5
print(numerical_variable)
print(class(numerical_variable))
logical_variable <- FALSE
print(logical_variable)
print(class(logical_variable))
```
using different types of variables
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543
```

bonus
```{r}
print(TRUE + TRUE)
print(TRUE + FALSE)
print(5 + TRUE)
```

```{r}
x <- NA
print(x == NA)
print(is.na(x))
```

```{r}
x <- 0 / 0
print(x)
print(is.na(x))
print(is.nan(x))
```

```{r}
print(round(2.5))
print(round(3.5))
```
```{r}
print(1/0)
```
